title: Classify AI-Related Threats
prompt: Classify each situation into the correct family: Model & data / Usage & output / Governance & ethics.

items.label: Incorrectly labeled data added to training
Hostile instruction hidden inside an analyzed PDF
Discriminatory response caused by an imbalanced dataset
Unable to explain the model's decision
AI agent executing an unauthorized command
Confidential data returned to another user

explain: Model & data: poisoning, tampering, data leakage. Usage & output: prompt injection, jailbreaking, hallucinations, code execution. Governance & ethics: bias, explainability, ethical considerations.
